content.caption:
What happens when anonymous hackers decide to remotely crank up supermarket refrigerators across Europe?

Quietly exploiting connected IoT systems, unknown actors forced thousands of commercial cooling units into sudden automatic defrosting.

Fresh food was put at risk while security teams scrambled to find the digital backdoor.

It is a stark reminder of how vulnerable our everyday supply chains are to cyber attacks.
